title: AppraisalTrigger
description: ITIP data archetype — appraisal trigger payload. Rootless (no GSM base extension). Types the event payload received by appraisal Mechanisms via their Receptor. Carries the appraisal rule type, subject identity, the subject's governed statement, and pre-fetched related ascriptions needed for evaluation. Source: ITIP (domain archetype for governance appraisal).

ruleType.description: Appraisal rule type URI identifying which governance rule to evaluate. Matches AppraisalRuleType.type (e.g., 'gsm:rules/appraisal/directive/norm/operationalization').

subjectType.description: GSM subject type of the entity being appraised.

subjectDefinitionId.description: Definition ID of the subject being appraised.

subject.description: The subject ascription's statement (governed payload). Contains the full JSONB statement of the latest in-effect ascription for the subject definition.

subjectMetadata.description: Ascription-level metadata not part of the statement JSONB. Populated by the BFF from lifecycle fields: ascription ID, status, version, timestamps, and any pre-computed values (e.g. statusDurationDays for comitology rules).

relatedAscriptions.description: Pre-fetched ascriptions and contextual data required for evaluation. Contents vary by rule type. For governance rules (NA-gov, NX-gov), includes pre-evaluated Norm assertion results from the Norm Evaluator service.
